info.description: Get the list of objects that make up the user's queue.
info.title: Spotify Web API

requests.description: Get Spotify catalog information for multiple albums identified by their Spotify IDs.
requests.name: Get Several Albums

requests.description: Get Spotify catalog information for a single album.
requests.name: Get Album
requests.note: Replace {{SPOTIFY_WEB_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Get Spotify catalog information about an album’s tracks.
Optional parameters can be used to limit the number of tracks returned.
requests.name: Get Album Tracks
requests.note: Replace {{SPOTIFY_WEB_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Get Spotify catalog information for several artists based on their Spotify IDs.
requests.name: Get Several Artists

requests.description: Get Spotify catalog information for a single artist identified by their unique Spotify ID.
requests.name: Get Artist
requests.note: Replace {{SPOTIFY_WEB_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Get Spotify catalog information about an artist's albums.
requests.name: Get Artist's Albums
requests.note: Replace {{SPOTIFY_WEB_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Get Spotify catalog information about artists similar to a given artist. Similarity is based on analysis of the Spotify community's [listening history](http://news.spotify.com/se/2010/02/03/related-artists/).
requests.name: Get Artist's Related Artists
requests.note: Replace {{SPOTIFY_WEB_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Get Spotify catalog information about an artist's top tracks by country.
requests.name: Get Artist's Top Tracks
requests.note: Replace {{SPOTIFY_WEB_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Get a low-level audio analysis for a track in the Spotify catalog. The audio analysis describes the track’s structure and musical content, including rhythm, pitch, and timbre.
requests.name: Get Track's Audio Analysis
requests.note: Replace {{SPOTIFY_WEB_API_KEY}} with your API key | Set Content-Type to multipart/form-data for file uploads | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Get audio features for multiple tracks based on their Spotify IDs.
requests.name: Get Tracks' Audio Features
requests.note: Replace {{SPOTIFY_WEB_API_KEY}} with your API key | Set Content-Type to multipart/form-data for file uploads

requests.description:
Get audio feature information for a single track identified by its unique
Spotify ID.
requests.name: Get Track's Audio Features
requests.note: Replace {{SPOTIFY_WEB_API_KEY}} with your API key | Set Content-Type to multipart/form-data for file uploads | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Get Spotify catalog information for several audiobooks identified by their Spotify IDs.
**Note: Audiobooks are only available for the US, UK, Ireland, New Zealand and Australia markets.**
requests.name: Get Several Audiobooks
requests.note: Replace {{SPOTIFY_WEB_API_KEY}} with your API key | Set Content-Type to multipart/form-data for file uploads

requests.description:
Get Spotify catalog information for a single audiobook.
**Note: Audiobooks are only available for the US, UK, Ireland, New Zealand and Australia markets.**
requests.name: Get an Audiobook
requests.note: Replace {{SPOTIFY_WEB_API_KEY}} with your API key | Set Content-Type to multipart/form-data for file uploads | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Get Spotify catalog information about an audiobook's chapters.
**Note: Audiobooks are only available for the US, UK, Ireland, New Zealand and Australia markets.**
requests.name: Get Audiobook Chapters
requests.note: Replace {{SPOTIFY_WEB_API_KEY}} with your API key | Set Content-Type to multipart/form-data for file uploads | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Get a list of categories used to tag items in Spotify (on, for example, the Spotify player’s “Browse” tab).
requests.name: Get Several Browse Categories

requests.description: Get a single category used to tag items in Spotify (on, for example, the Spotify player’s “Browse” tab).
requests.name: Get Single Browse Category
requests.note: Replace {{SPOTIFY_WEB_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Get a list of Spotify playlists tagged with a particular category.
requests.name: Get Category's Playlists
requests.note: Replace {{SPOTIFY_WEB_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Get a list of Spotify featured playlists (shown, for example, on a Spotify player's 'Browse' tab).
requests.name: Get Featured Playlists

requests.description: Get a list of new album releases featured in Spotify (shown, for example, on a Spotify player’s “Browse” tab).
requests.name: Get New Releases

requests.description:
Get Spotify catalog information for several chapters identified by their Spotify IDs.
**Note: Chapters are only available for the US, UK, Ireland, New Zealand and Australia markets.**
requests.name: Get Several Chapters

requests.description:
Get Spotify catalog information for a single chapter.
**Note: Chapters are only available for the US, UK, Ireland, New Zealand and Australia markets.**
requests.name: Get a Chapter
requests.note: Replace {{SPOTIFY_WEB_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Get Spotify catalog information for several episodes based on their Spotify IDs.

Get Spotify catalog information for a single episode identified by its

requests.description: Get the list of markets where Spotify is available.
